newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Sharif wins vote of confidence.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Sharif wins vote of confidence.

text.p: Pakistan's new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif won a vote of confidence in the 217-seat National Assembly (lower house) on Wednesday, witnesses said. They said 181 members voted in favour of Sharif, who has yet to announce the composition of his cabinet. Sharif was elected prime minister by the house on Monday by 177 votes to 16.
Sharif was sworn in by President Farooq Leghari on Monday after leading his Pakistan Muslim League to a crushing victory in the February 3 general election.
The election followed Leghari's dismissal of a government led by Benazir Bhutto on November 5 on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
Political sources said earlier on Wednesday that Sharif had drawn up a final list of cabinet members, but some decisions remained to be taken on allocation of portfolios.
A caretaker government under Meraj Khalid stepped down on Monday.
